cinemaMetropolisOpeningSubtitle.en: The night shift… and the machines woke up on their own

cinemaMetropolisControlsHint.ar: اضغط يسارًا أو يمينًا لتركض، المس لتضرب بالمفتاح، اسحب للأعلى لتقفز وللجانب لتندفع
cinemaMetropolisControlsHint.en: Hold left or right to run, tap to swing the wrench, swipe up to jump and sideways to dash
cinemaMetropolisControlsHint.description: Controls line on the opening card

cinemaMetropolisHero.description: Name of the hero, the night engineer (miftah = wrench/key)

cinemaMetropolisIntroOne.ar: دقّ جرس الوردية… ولم يخرج أحد من المصنع.
cinemaMetropolisIntroOne.en: The shift bell rang… and nobody came out of the works.

cinemaMetropolisIntroTwo.ar: مِفتاح، مهندس الليل، حمل مفتاحه وفانوسه ودخل.
cinemaMetropolisIntroTwo.en: Miftah, the night engineer, took his wrench and his lantern and went in.

cinemaMetropolisMachineOf.description: Chapter card subtitle before a boss; numbers are pre-formatted

cinemaMetropolisBossPlate.description: Boss bar name plate: the machine name and which machine of how many; numbers are pre-formatted

cinemaMetropolisPressLine.ar: يدقّ الساعة في الأرض. لا تقف حيث تقع الدقّة.
cinemaMetropolisPressLine.en: It stamps the hour into the floor. Never stand where the beat falls.

cinemaMetropolisBoilerLine.ar: ينفث بخاره بنظام. اقرأ النظام قبل أن يقرأك.
cinemaMetropolisBoilerLine.en: It vents its steam in patterns. Read the pattern before it reads you.

cinemaMetropolisSpiderLine.ar: أرجلها أسلاك، وكل سلك يبحث عن مقبس… وأنت المقبس.
cinemaMetropolisSpiderLine.en: Its legs are cables, and every cable wants a socket. You are the socket.

cinemaMetropolisTitanLine.ar: يرفع ويخفض كما يشاء. اركب المنصّات ولا تثق بالأرض.
cinemaMetropolisTitanLine.en: It raises and lowers as it pleases. Ride the platforms and trust no floor.

cinemaMetropolisDynamoLine.ar: قلب المدينة كلّه. كل ما تعلّمته… دفعة واحدة.
cinemaMetropolisDynamoLine.en: The heart of the whole city. Everything you learned, all at once.

cinemaMetropolisTauntOne.ar: «مكبس واحد؟ عندي مدينة كاملة من الآلات!»
cinemaMetropolisTauntOne.en: “One press? I have a whole city of machines!”

cinemaMetropolisTauntTwo.en: “Steam, cables, lifts… choose how you fall.”

cinemaMetropolisTauntThree.ar: «الطابق الأخير يا مهندس. هذا المصعد ينزل فقط.»
cinemaMetropolisTauntThree.en: “Top floor, engineer. This lift only goes down.”

cinemaMetropolisTauntFour.en: “Enough! I will run the Mother myself!”
cinemaMetropolisTauntFour.description: Taunt after boss 4, before the final boss

cinemaMetropolisBaronBeaten.description: The Baron's line when the final boss falls

cinemaMetropolisTauntSigned.description: Signature line under a taunt card

cinemaMetropolisEndSubtitle.ar: وعادت أنوار المدينة تشتعل واحدًا واحدًا.
cinemaMetropolisEndSubtitle.en: And the city's lights came back on, one by one.

cinemaMetropolisLostSubtitle.ar: ربحت الآلات هذه الوردية. غدًا وردية أخرى.
cinemaMetropolisLostSubtitle.en: The machines won this shift. Tomorrow is another.

cinemaMetropolisReelBack.description: HUD flash when a life comes back after a boss

cinemaMetropolisPhaseUp.description: HUD flash when a boss enters its next phase
